merged.author: nickyyOO
merged.untrustedBody:
**Before:** a level with expanded level data (for example a custom level whose collision outgrows its place) crashed rac1 before the level loaded, in the sky or ship glass code. merged.title: fix(macos): HDR on Vulkan through MoltenVK renders; Metal choice is MoltenVK again
merged.author: Veradictus
merged.untrustedBody:
HDR on with the Vulkan renderer on macOS (MoltenVK) showed a black window while the game ran underneath.

Cause: `set_metadata()` calls `vkSetHdrMetadataEXT`, which MoltenVK turns into the CAMetalLayer's HDR10 `CAEDRMetadata` with `opticalOutputScale: 1`. Core Animation then reads the scRGB swapchain's 1.0 as one nit, so the whole picture is next to black.

Fix: on macOS, the scRGB (extended linear sRGB) swapchain sends no metadata; EDR maps 1.0 to SDR white by itself. The layer otherwise matches what the old Metal renderer set up (#607): RGBA16Float, kCGColorSpaceExtendedLinearSRGB, EDR on, framebufferOnly off (MoltenVK does this for VK_COLOR_SPACE_EXTENDED_SRGB_LINEAR_EXT with storage usage), the same encode pass, paper white and peak from the display's EDR headroom. HDR10 output and every other system keep sending metadata. HDR.md says so.

Also reverts #697: the game has no Metal renderer any more, so the launcher's Metal choice on macOS is Vulkan through MoltenVK again, as #657 se

merged.title: fix(rac2): take a dead enemy copy off its squad's list when its slot is given out again
merged.author: Veradictus
merged.untrustedBody:
NG++'s enemy copies are added to their squad's group list (enemy_copies.c, join_group), but the game never takes a moby off a list: its lists only ever hold placed mobys, whose slots CreateMoby never hands out again. A copy's slot is handed out again two frames after it dies, to the bolts it drops or the next spawn, and from then on the list names that moby as a member of the squad.

Two things followed on Boldan in challenge mode:

- **Frozen mobys.** BuildActiveMobyChain (func_002A08A0) chained such a moby once from the table and once more through its group. Chaining a moby twice cuts every moby chained between the two out of that frame's updates, so bolts and enemies stood frozen while the pool still had room.
- **Memory corruption.** The squad's controller ran its member code on the new moby and wrote an enemy's floats into a bolt's pvars. The bolt's update then read one of them as a pointer: a SIGBUS at 0xBCF5FF88 in UpdateBoltPickupMoby (func_00300F58), the user's crash on fff037

merged.title: fix(port): read a mod's enemy copies' joint modifiers in the port's memory
merged.author: Veradictus
merged.untrustedBody:
Going Commando with NG++: the "vertex explosions" (sheets of triangles across the screen) came from enemy copies, starting with Maktar's Megacorp Chickenbot (class 2638).

**Cause.** If an enemy's pvars are larger than a pool slot's 0x80 bytes, its copy keeps them in the port's own region (`GUEST_PORT`, the room in `enemy_copies.c`, at 0xE0xxxxxx). The Chickenbot's class links a joint-modifier node from its pvars into the moby's list at +0x54 (its head turn). `scene::moby_pose` read only game RAM, and masked that address to 25 bits. So it read the executable's code as the modifier, and the copy's joints came out huge or NaN. The game's own read-back of poses (`openrac_game_moby_chain`) got the same garbage.

**Fix.**
- `scene::set_port_memory` gives the evaluator that region, set in `main.cpp`. Keys, pose layers and modifiers are now read from it when they live there.
- A pose that still comes out non-finite is dropped, so the moby is drawn as stored and its vertices stay in place.

merged.title: Use exact shader feature variants across renderers
merged.author: pezzadev
merged.untrustedBody:
Vulkan no longer uses a generic shader while compiling a feature variant. It draws with the exact pipeline and prewarms combinations recorded on previous runs. opened.author: Veradictus

HDR on with the Vulkan renderer on macOS (MoltenVK) showed a black window while the game ran underneath.

Cause: `set_metadata()` calls `vkSetHdrMetadataEXT`, which MoltenVK turns into the CAMetalLayer's HDR10 `CAEDRMetadata` with `opticalOutputScale: 1`. Core Animation then reads the scRGB swapchain's 1.0 as one nit, so the whole picture is next to black.

opened.author: Veradictus
opened.untrustedBody:
Going Commando with NG++: the "vertex explosions" (sheets of triangles across the screen) came from enemy copies, starting with Maktar's Megacorp Chickenbot (class 2638).

**Cause.** If an enemy's pvars are larger than a pool slot's 0x80 bytes, its copy keeps them in the port's own region (`GUEST_PORT`, the room in `enemy_copies.c`, at 0xE0xxxxxx). The Chickenbot's class links a joint-modifier node from its pvars into the moby's list at +0x54 (its head turn). `scene::moby_pose` read only game RAM, and masked that address to 25 bits. **Fix.**
- `scene::set_port_memory` gives the evaluator that region, set in `main.cpp`. Keys, pose layers and modifiers are now read from it when they live there.
- A pose that still comes out non-finite is dropped, so the moby is drawn as stored and its vertices stay in place.
